name: Ashidaki Kururi
source:
A librarian working at the library of the Academy. Married, her maiden name Toukamachi.

A graduate of the school, she returned as a librarian after graduating from junior college. A gentle, easygoing married woman who loves books and the academy library.

She takes a liking to Masaki, who often visits the library, and begins to harbor feelings for him...

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/peach/product/chijo2/index.html]official site[/url]]
